header: Where Open Source Minds Come Together.
terminal-text: Hi, welcome to Open Minds Club!
desc-about-us: The Open Minds club is a student scientific club at the USTHB created in 2009. Its primary goal is to foster a spirit of sharing and collaboration among students and to promote the Open Source philosophy.
desc-events: Our events are regularly organized with a collaborative, informative, competitive and fun approach, providing a platform where we can share our knowledge and promote the free and open source philosophy to our attendees.

desc-trusted-by: The trust of our partners reflects our commitment to long-term, reliable relationships.
desc-workshops-tuto: The club's spirit of sharing is brought to life through training sessions and workshops run by experienced students and graduates eager to share their knowledge in any field.
desc-open-wiki: The community is dedicated to the exchange and collaboration of knowledge. Open Wiki, a platform developed by the club, facilitates knowledge sharing and encourages open source contributions.
